name: Immoral Visit 3 -Damasareta Watashi ga Shuuchi Roshutsu o Yamerarenai Riyuu-
original_name: Immoral visit3 -騙された私が羞恥露出をやめられない理由-
source:
Natsumi went past the park one evening on her way home from club activities
and saw her friends Haruka and Hinano stripping for an audience.
She panicked and ran away, but couldn't stop thinking about what she saw.
During club activities the next day she was downright wet with excitement... but she'd never masturbated before.
She was full of aroused feelings without understand why. So there in the locker room, she

Meanwhile, her junior and basketball partner Suika watched... and videotaped.
It was the first step into a new world for Natsumi.
